functie: Associate Vice President of Instructional Design
citaat: UTI instructors spend two to four hours daily on manual grading of short-answer questions in lab documents.
samenvatting: Instructeurs kwijt 2 tot 4 uur per dag aan handmatig nakijken van labs.

functie: Associate Vice President of Instructional Design
citaat: Current Blackboard short-answer automatic grading systems fail if student responses are not 100 percent character-perfect. Students currently upload fillable PDF lab documents to Blackboard and receive minimal written feedback.
samenvatting: Blackboard-autograding werkt niet bij open antwoorden, dus alles gaat handmatig.

functie: Associate Vice President of Instructional Design
citaat: Students currently upload fillable PDF lab documents to Blackboard and receive minimal written feedback.
samenvatting: Studenten krijgen nu nauwelijks geschreven feedback terug op hun labs.

functie: Associate Vice President of Instructional Design
citaat: UTI serves approximately 20,000 students across 16 programs, with all courses containing hands-on digital labs.
samenvatting: 20.000 studenten en 16 programma's, elk vak met labs die nagekeken moeten worden.

functie: Associate Vice President of Instructional Design
citaat: Robert Jordan requested integration directly into Blackboard Ultra, UTI's current learning management system. The solution should accept rubrics or documents as a knowledge base for grading and feedback generation.
samenvatting: Integratie in Blackboard Ultra met hun eigen rubrics is de harde eis.

functie: Associate Vice President of Instructional Design
citaat: UTI seeks both formative feedback (immediate student feedback on uploads) and summative feedback (instructor review and adjustment). Ideal implementation includes confidence scores indicating AI certainty about grading judgments.
samenvatting: Ze willen confidence scores zodat de instructeur weet wanneer hij moet ingrijpen.

functie: Associate Vice President of Instructional Design
citaat: Robert Jordan's senior vice president of education must weigh in on the implementation decision. UTI's legal and IT teams must review the product for security and integration compliance before implementation.
samenvatting: SVP of Education beslist, legal en IT moeten eerst door de security-check.

functie: Associate Vice President of Instructional Design
citaat: UTI instructors face long teaching hours (8-10 hours daily) followed by 3-4 hours of grading. UTI instructor shortage is exacerbated by industry pay rates exceeding teaching compensation, making workload reduction critical for recruitment and retention.
samenvatting: Nakijklast bovenop lange lesdagen drijft instructeurs weg, werving is het knelpunt.

functie: Associate Vice President of Instructional Design
citaat: UTI proposes 12-week pilot with approximately 120-125 students in HVAC 101 class across four teaching sessions. Accuracy and consistency of grading are essential metrics for pilot success; if pilot succeeds, implementation desired across entire organization.
samenvatting: Zij stelden zelf de pilot voor, succescriteria zijn nauwkeurigheid en werklastdaling.

citaat: Nikki Sneddon highlighted UTI's unique structure with multiple campuses delivering identical curriculum and maintaining consistent standards across locations. Tool could aggregate data across Phoenix, Florida, and other campuses to identify systemic support needs.
samenvatting: Zij willen kruis-campus consistentie zien, dat is een tweede koopreden naast tijd.

functie: Associate Vice President of Instructional Design
citaat: Robert Jordan confirmed that VPAT and pricing information are required before presenting to organizational leadership for approval.
samenvatting: Zonder VPAT-toegankelijkheidsdocument en prijs komt het niet bij leiderschap.

functie: Associate Vice President of Instructional Design
citaat: Statistics dashboard flags inconsistent marking between multiple instructors by showing how often markers edit AI grades compared to the rubric-based AI scoring, signaling potential need for calibration sessions between instructors.
samenvatting: Wij verkochten kalibratie-inzicht als tweede waarde naast tijdwinst.

functie: Associate Vice President of Instructional Design
citaat: Our pricing is $3 per student per month, discounts apply if our tool gets licensed over multiple years in advance. We understand UTI runs shorter programs, so instead of pricing off a single headcount, we use your average active students across the year.
samenvatting: Wij prijsden op gemiddeld actieve studenten om hun korte programma's te dekken.

citaat: Het management benoemt als strategische pijler: enhancing operations to make the most efficient use of resources, binnen North Star Phase II.
samenvatting: Leiderschap moet efficiency bewijzen, dat is de taal waarin onze case moet landen.
